messages:
samir: Heads up — tried running a full day WFH off a portable solar generator today. Laptop stayed up but the ISP modem/router kept rebooting every time the inverter synced. Lost Zoom twice. Any ideas? pic: https://i.imgur.com/solaroffice.jpg :sweat_smile:

lena: ouch. is the modem plugged into the inverter output or into a separate battery/UPS outlet? some inverter systems have a transfer event that trips consumer gear.

samir: plugged into the inverter output (had limited outlets). the generator shows a short 'transfer' event every ~20s in its status. when clouds pass the panels it blips and the modem drops PPP. voltage looks like it sags briefly.

devon: big +1 for a small UPS just for the modem. inverters can have short transient spikes or phase shifts that screw with DSL/PPPoE.

jordan: if you can grab the modem logs, look for pppd disconnects. adding persist/maxfail in pppd or enabling auto-reconnect on the modem helps. also check modem firmware — some have a 'stay connected' option.

samir: pasted the tail of the modem log I pulled via serial: ```Apr 23 10:12:08 pppd[1234]: pppd 2.4.7 started by root, uid 0
Apr 23 10:12:28 pppd[1234]: Connection terminated.
Apr 23 10:12:29 pppd[1234]: Exit.```

maria-g: also check the inverter settings for 'silent' or 'eco' mode — those can toggle output to save battery and cause tiny dropouts. physically isolating the router/modem to a small line-interactive UPS often fixes it.

devon: alternatively, swap modem and router roles: some cheap ISP combo boxes are power-sensitive. a $50 UPS with AVR (automatic voltage regulation) will smooth those sags.

wifi-bot: network-health: pings to 8.8.8.8 during the main outage window (10:12:20-10:12:40) = 0/5, RTT unknown.

lena: quick test: next time, unplug panels for 5 mins and see if the inverter stops transferring. if it does, then it's panel input fluctuations causing the issue.

samir: good plan. thanks everyone — will try a cheap UPS tonight and report back. bonus: my monstera survived the solar day :seedling: (see terrible coffee mug in the photo) :joy:
